nodes.description: Public uint256 counter tracking the number of wedding messages stored; incremented on every createWeedingMessage call.
Private mapping(uint256 => string) storing the wedding message text indexed by message id.
Private mapping(uint256 => string) storing the author/assistant name for each message id.
Private address set once in the constructor to msg.sender; used as the access-control gate for cashback.
Contract constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
Payable public function that writes a message and its author into storage mappings and increments amountOfMessages.
Public view function returning the author and message for a given tokenId from the private mappings.
Public function requiring msg.sender == owner and transferring the entire contract balance to the caller.
Caller-controlled msg.sender used during construction to set the privileged owner address.
Caller-controlled msg.sender compared against owner in cashback and used as the transfer recipient.
Arithmetic operation amountOfMessages = amountOfMessages + 1 performed on the message counter.
External value transfer payable(address(msg.sender)).transfer(address(this).balance) sending the full contract balance to the caller.
String parameter of createWeedingMessage holding the author name, written to _assistant.
String parameter of createWeedingMessage holding the message body, written to _wedMessages.
uint256 parameter of getWedMessage used as the lookup key into the storage mappings.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read inside the constructor to initialize the contract.
msg.sender is assigned to the privileged owner state variable during construction.
createWeedingMessage writes the message parameter into _wedMessages.
createWeedingMessage writes the author parameter into _assistant.
createWeedingMessage reads and updates amountOfMessages to derive the next message id.
amountOfMessages is the operand of the increment operation, feeding the counter value into the arithmetic.
The result of amountOfMessages + 1 is written back into the amountOfMessages state variable.
The iAm parameter is consumed by createWeedingMessage and stored in _assistant.
The message parameter is consumed by createWeedingMessage and stored in _wedMessages.
The tokenId parameter is consumed by getWedMessage as the mapping lookup key.
getWedMessage reads _wedMessages to return the stored message.
getWedMessage reads _assistant to return the stored author name.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the require statement of cashback, gating execution on caller identity.
cashback reads the owner state variable to enforce the msg.sender == owner precondition before any transfer.
cashback triggers the external balance transfer to the caller, performing an external call that can re-enter the contract.
The balance transfer to msg.sender invokes the recipient, allowing a callback into cashback before state is settled.
msg.sender is used directly as the recipient address of the balance transfer performed by cashback.

normalization_plan.reason: The iAm parameter has no independent security semantics and only serves as input to the createWeedingMessage function.
The message parameter is only data passed into createWeedingMessage and should be folded into that core function node.
The tokenId parameter is only used as the lookup key inside getWedMessage and has no standalone semantic role.
